name: apothecary_stomper_vigilance_attacks_without_tapping
notes: Printed: 'Vigilance (Attacking doesn't cause this creature to tap.)' Seat 0 attacks with Apothecary Stomper (4/4) and a Plain Brute (3/3, no vigilance); seat 1 has no blockers and takes 4 + 3 (20 -> 13). Afterwards the Stomper is untapped and the Brute is tapped.
